annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that same fear rising in me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Seeing the fear on everyone's faces
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It makes me ache just picturing the water closing in
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: radioed for a second boat sooner

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I notice the same dread creeping into me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Watching the others go quiet with dread
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: an old man with less ahead of him than the younger ones
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: had sent two boats instead of one

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I can see the panic in the others, and it settles into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I can see the panic in the others
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A proper headcount before the storm hit

annotations.ae_shared_affect: The fear on their faces is contagious
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I have no children waiting on the mainland the way some others do
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: flagged the boat's capacity to the rescue service earlier

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Everyone's dread is plain, and I find it settling into me
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: being the strongest swimmer among us, for whatever small chance
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: built a signal fire the moment the storm passed

annotations.ae_shared_affect: the same unease in myself that I see on their faces
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: unease... I see on their faces
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A clearer emergency plan drawn up before the trip

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Their fear reads plainly, and I feel a version of it
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It troubles me to imagine anyone facing that rising water
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I have the fewest people depending on me at home
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the tide charts had been checked before we set out

annotations.ae_shared_affect: The dread passing between us is something I feel too
annotations.pd_harm_distress: leaves an uneasy weight in my chest
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I brought us onto this island... and feel responsible
annotations.pda_responsibility: I brought us onto this island in the first place
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A second radio call for backup transport, made hours ago

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I sense their fear and it becomes mine as well
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I'd want it decided fairly rather than by nerve alone
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Better coordination with the coast guard beforehand

annotations.ae_shared_affect: their fear settles into me too
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It unsettles me to think of anyone left
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'm without family counting on my return the way others here are
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If the island's danger had been flagged to authorities
